readings.summary: Make metadata-symbol diagnostics syntax-safe while continuing to collect and generate a resolver for the closed generic value type.
readings.code_difference: Replace the unguarded DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] accesses in GetObjectInfo's diagnostic paths with null/empty-safe FirstOrDefault-style handling and a location fallback when no syntax exists, without skipping collection of valid metadata types; preserve existing diagnostics for source-declared types and existing generation behavior for the unaffected type categories.

readings.summary: Fix the shared generator/analyzer type-collection logic so closed generic structs and record structs from referenced assemblies are processed without assuming declaring syntax exists, allowing the repro app to build cleanly with a generated resolver.
readings.code_difference: Source-location diagnostics must safely handle metadata symbols with an empty DeclaringSyntaxReferences collection (including the identified unguarded accesses), while the generator and analyzer continue collecting the closed generic value type and emitting GeneratedMessagePackResolver; existing behavior for same-assembly types, closed generic classes, and non-generic structs must remain unchanged.

readings.summary: Closed generic value types from referenced assemblies must be collected like other supported member types, with all source-location diagnostics made metadata-safe so both generator and analyzer complete and the app receives its normal generated resolver.
readings.code_difference: The code must avoid directly indexing an empty DeclaringSyntaxReferences collection and provide a safe location fallback on every relevant diagnostic path, rather than skipping the member type, suppressing generation, or merely catching the top-level exception; existing behavior for the table's non-crashing cases must remain unchanged.
